uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.after.description: One container, system-authored label, hidden details. The chat surface keeps user and agent bubbles unchanged.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.after.p2: Same content. The visible body is one short system sentence; reviewers expand Details only when they need run evidence. Tone is reinforced by the octagon icon and the "System alert" label, not just red.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.after.title: System notice replacement
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.before.description: The same content rendered through the existing user-bubble + warning-callout path. Two containers, same gray background as user comments, and the warning icon is forced inside a chat row.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.before.p2: Author reads as You even though the author is the Paperclip system. Two containers stack the warning inside a user-style bubble, and operational evidence is always visible.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.before.title: Today's nested treatment
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.description: Replaces the current pattern where a Paperclip-authored warning renders inside a user-style chat bubble. The notice is one container, system-styled, with hidden-by-default operational metadata. Tone is conveyed by icon, label, and color together so it stays accessible.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.handoffDesc: What the Phase 4 UI implementation should preserve from this design.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection1.descriptio: Each tone pairs a unique icon and tone label so the notice is recognizable without color. Collapsed is the default; the Details affordance reveals operational metadata only when reviewers ask for it.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection1.title: Three tones, two states
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection2.descriptio: Side-by-side with adjacent comment types so reviewers can confirm the system row reads as a system row — full width, no avatar gutter, no chat bubble — while user and agent comments keep their existing rounded bubbles.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection2.title: Distinct from user and agent comments
